source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Jimena
I’m looking for layout and design support for a response (proposal) to an RFP. There would be strict rules around the file size, page numbers, etc. There will also be the reality of the turnaround time being last-minute because of the nature of RFP timelines. Although I suspect the RFP will come out this month. 1) Do you have experience with this type of proposal support? 2) If so, how do you prepare for these types of timelines w/ clients,what if edits are needed from clients until its final?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Thank you, Jimena! Same to you. I just looked at the current proposal. The full document is 83 pages, including all letters, forms, etc. Out of the 83 pages, there are 55 pages that have a graphic touch. Would you be able to give me an approximate budget (range) for your support on the project? Also. can you include a budget with 1 simple infographic and 1 simple map plus another budget without these items? Thank you!

requested_budget_options: with one simple infographic and one simple map

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Good morning Jimena - TPEC (engineering firm) wants to move forward with you. They're going to ask you to sign an NDA, heads up. Once we've got that squared away, I can share the previous proposal and supporting docs., so that you can get started on the layout, branding, resumes, etc. Note that the RFP hasn't been posted yet, so we're trying to just get ready to go in the interim. Thanks!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Excellent! Also, we have a template from the last time we submitted, and there may not be a need for maps, infographics, etc. So it may be fewer hours of work ( lower than $4500).
